items.passage: Transcript: Good morning, this is Farah Delacroix, manager of the campus bookstore, with a note for anyone who pre-ordered course books online. Normally you'd collect those at our front counter, and that's also where returns go. This week, though, the counter is being rebuilt, so pre-orders are being handed out from Room 106 in Quillon House, just across the courtyard. Returns are a different story. Those stay right here in the bookstore, at the side window next to the café, and the usual return deadline hasn't changed. I've had a few people ask whether the shop itself is closed. It isn't. Pick-up in Room 106 runs from ten to four, even though the shop keeps its usual hours of eight to six. And normally we'd find your order from your student card, but this week we can't look orders up that way, so please bring the order number from your confirmation email.
items.prompt: [Announcement — Campus bookstore] Why does the speaker say, "Returns are a different story"?
choices: To point out that returns are not moving to the same place as pre-orders
To warn that returns will be paused for the rest of this week
To signal that returns have an earlier deadline than pick-ups
To admit that returns have caused long queues this term
items.correct_answer: To point out that returns are not moving to the same place as pre-orders
items.explanation: Just before the line the speaker says pre-orders "are being handed out from Room 106 in Quillon House"; right after it she says returns "stay right here in the bookstore, at the side window next to the café." So the line marks that returns are not following pre-orders to Quillon House. "To warn that returns will be paused for the rest of this week" is wrong: returns continue at the side window. "To signal that returns have an earlier deadline than pick-ups" is wrong: "the usual return deadline hasn't changed," and no pick-up deadline is given. "To admit that returns have caused long queues this term" is wrong: queues are never mentioned; the line introduces where returns go.
